notes.title: The title was changed to Rush!
notes.content:
Thank you for visiting our page.

We have changed the title of the game from Laugsh!
I have always felt that the spelling "Laugsh" was hard to remember, and I wanted to make the title easier to understand.

Rush" means "Rush! Rush! I thought it would be a perfect title for this game, in which you and 100 other ghost players are going to fight against aliens.
I hope that users will feel some sense of familiarity with the game.

The team is working hard to complete the development of Rush! Please wait a little longer.
Thank you for your continued support!

From the game director, Tokitamago.

notes.title: Thank you for visiting the Tokyo Game Show!
notes.content:
Thank you for visiting the Laugsh! page.

Laugsh! participated in the Tokyo Game Show held from September 21st to 24th, 2023.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457858/3d85c8c508d98417bd1e544181d0363640323765.jpg[/img]

We greatly appreciate everyone who visited the Laugsh! booth during the event!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457858/e691f6bade14835a43a51a99282d543327e1a123.jpg[/img]

Based on the feedback from all of you who played, we will continue to work hard on development to make the game even better for next year's release.

Please continue to look forward to the release of Laugsh! in the future!

notes.title: We will exhibit at Tokyo Game Show 2023!
notes.content:
Thank you for visiting the Laugsh! page.
We are pleased to inform you that Laugsh! will be exhibiting at the Tokyo Game Show 2023 to be held at Makuhari Messe from September 21 to 24.

Laugsh! will be exhibited in the Kodansha booth at the Tokyo Game Show.
You will be able to play a demo version of Laugsh!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457858/edfa1ddc6913b5c8ffa50915fcfabf22baf4438d.gif[/img]

notes.title: We will keep you updated on the development of this game with news
notes.content:
Thank you for visiting the "Laugsh! -Red Horizon" page.
Laugsh! is a 2D action game in development for release in 2024.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457858/48dd25385fd5e426be39bd273b2515948cf083a0.jpg[/img]

Laugsh!, which co-opts play data from all over the world collected from servers.
It is a game that is easy to understand, fun, and offers a sense of flirting that cannot be experienced in any other game.

We will be posting updates on the development status.
While you are waiting for the release, we hope you will take a look at this space.

[b]Aliens VS Earth Defense Forces[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41457858/15ded57c20ce38f75123bff490fa99994c0411ec.jpg[/img].

It has been 10 years since the Earth was invaded by aliens.
The defense forces fighting on Earth, where the human race is on the verge of extinction, are now on the verge of total annihilation.
In such a situation, the strongest army is completed by the "Ghost Player System" invented by a scientist, Doctor Psychopath!
Together with friends gathered from all over the world, the human race begins its counterattack!
